description.value: Fable Café is the brick-and-mortar café of Fable, a Certified B Corp best known for its premium tableware and homewares brand. Situated in Vancouver's South Granville neighbourhood, it serves espresso drinks, rotating pour overs, matcha, hojicha, and seasonal beverages alongside sweet bites. The café runs a no-tipping model with living wages for staff and charges nothing extra for alternative milks.
